name: Cursor
summary: Anysphere's AI code editor; consumes Agent Skills natively and layers runtime-specific frontmatter keys on top of the standard fields.

skillDiscovery.skillFormat: folder containing a SKILL.md file with optional scripts/, references/, and assets/ directories
skillDiscovery.notes: Cursor also discovers skills inside nested project subdirectories, so monorepos can place skills in folders such as apps/web/.cursor/skills/. The Packsmith v0.1 target adapter installs a .cursor/rules/packsmith rule pack (src/lib/targets.mjs), which predates native skill discovery.

frontmatter.notes: name is required (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must match the parent folder name) and description is required (used by the agent to determine relevance). paths scopes activation to comma-separated or list glob patterns; the legacy globs field is still accepted as a fallback. disable-model-invocation includes the skill only via explicit /skill-name invocation. icon and color style badge presentation. metadata is an arbitrary string-to-string map.
